TPG questions

What is the cheapest TPG NBN plan?

NBN25 NBN 25/10 at $59.99/mo for 6 months, then $79.99/mo. That is $839.88 over the first year (checked 10 October 2026).

Does TPG let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. TPG only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give TPG 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. TPG asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.

Which mobile network does TPG use?

TPG runs on the Vodafone Network, which covers about 96.0% of Australians.

Has TPG raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for TPG since 8 September 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
